name: Spanish Cream
description: Historical recipe from The Whitehouse Cookbook (1887). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

instructions.text: Soak half a box of gelatine in one quart of milk for an hour
Place it on the fire and stir often
Beat the yolks of three eggs very light with a cupful of sugar
Stir into the scalding milk and heat until it begins to thicken (it should not boil, or it will curdle)
Remove from the fire and strain through thin muslin or tarlatan
When nearly cold flavor with vanilla or lemon
Wet a dish or mold in cold water and set aside to stiffen

source.author: F.L. Gillette
source.originalInstructions:
1. Soak half a box of gelatine in one quart of milk for an hour
2. Place it on the fire and stir often
3. Beat the yolks of three eggs very light with a cupful of sugar
4. Stir into the scalding milk and heat until it begins to thicken (it should not boil, or it will curdle)
5. Remove from the fire and strain through thin muslin or tarlatan
6. When nearly cold flavor with vanilla or lemon
7. Wet a dish or mold in cold water and set aside to stiffen
